A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TimePre and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary material. Supplementary Sections 6–7 in v1 correspond to Appendices A–B in v2, supporting a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original forecasting experiments on six datasets, computational measurements, normalization analyses, and hypothesis-count and backbone ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark and ablation results and adds an InstanceNorm comparison on Electricity.

M1.justification: Both versions describe trimmed, reversible SIN, a linear temporal encoder, trajectory and confidence heads, relaxed WTA plus confidence-calibration loss, and single-pass inference. Corrected order-statistic indices clarify the already described trimming procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Electricity, Exchange, Solar, Traffic, Taxi, and Wiki, with the same represented forecasting tasks. The dataset characteristics and horizons in Table 6 are unchanged.

E2.justification: InstanceNorm becomes an evaluated comparator alongside BatchNorm, LayerNorm, and GroupNorm in Table 3. The separate MeanScaler visual comparison disappears. The principal forecasting and backbone comparator sets remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Appendix B.2 revises the CRPS-Sum specification to explicitly aggregate channels before scoring; v1 specified only summing time-step CRPS. CKA evaluation is also removed. Retained splits, horizons, and training budgets are unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish that existing results were recomputed.

E4.justification: v2 removes the CKA representation analysis, the complete covariance study in v1 Section 4.4/Figure 5, and Figure 1's MeanScaler comparison. It adds the InstanceNorm control while retaining hypothesis-count and backbone ablations. This substantially revises the diagnostic evidence concerning stabilization.

E5.justification: v1 identifies seeds 3141, 3142, 3143, 42, and 43; v2 retains five-seed reporting but omits their identities. Standard-deviation reporting in Table 1 and standard-error reporting in Tables 2 and 5 remain unchanged. No increase in runs is reported.

E6.justification: Table 3 adds InstanceNorm results: Distortion 9712±482 and CRPS-Sum 0.0623±0.0084. CKA values and the removed visual analyses' findings disappear; numerical entries in Tables 1, 2, 4, and 5 remain unchanged. v2 also deletes erroneous prose assigning Exchange distortion 0.0796 to DeepAR and the best Solar backbone result to TimeMixer.

T1.justification: Equations 6–7 replace raw sequence indices with order-statistic indices, correcting their mismatch with the stated trimmed estimator. Appendix B.2 also explicitly defines channel-aggregated targets and predictive distributions for CRPS-Sum. No new theorem or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The introduction drops the first-framework priority claim and qualifies its performance contribution as state-of-the-art or highly competitive. The explicit stable-scaling contribution is removed. The central claims about combining lightweight forecasting with MCL through SIN remain.

C2.justification: v2 removes the CKA and decorrelation interpretations and most discussion of the retained ablations, including balanced hypothesis utilization and TiDE's failure on Solar. It newly characterizes SIN as preconditioning rather than increased model expressiveness. These substantially reduce the explanatory discussion, although the central scale-imbalance diagnosis remains.

D1.justification: Appendix B.2 newly identifies the GluonTS implementation basis and channel-aggregation instructions for CRPS-Sum. The specific Wiki Kaggle source citation and link are removed. Hardware, training hyperparameters, and general GluonTS/author-code access disclosures otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 removes citations concerning CKA, covariance conditioning, GAS-Norm, RMLP, KANMixer, and several peripheral applications. It retains the central MCL, TimeMCL, and lightweight-forecasting lineage while narrowing novelty positioning. Much of the expanded main related work already appeared in v1's supplement.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, related work, and method exposition undergo extensive rewriting. Contributions are consolidated, experimental discussion is shortened substantially, and supplementary sections become Appendices A–B. These are broad narrative changes beyond scientific additions and deletions.

P2.justification: The document changes from two columns to one, with extensive resizing and relocation of figures and tables. Figure 1 loses its lower panel, Figure 5 disappears, and Table 3 gains InstanceNorm while losing its CKA column. Table 5 now appears within the reference pages.

improvement.justification: The added InstanceNorm control directly strengthens validation of SIN, while corrected trimming equations and explicit CRPS-Sum aggregation improve mathematical clarity. Removing table-inconsistent comparisons and narrowing some claims also improves precision without changing the principal results. Loss of diagnostic analyses, ablation interpretation, and exact seed identifiers limits these gains, making the overall improvement modest.
